about_the_game:
Soar through a massive, ever-shifting cave full of danger, discovery, and high-stakes flying. Dodge tight gaps, rising water, and unpredictable terrain as you climb toward the surface. Make it to the top, and you’ll earn more than just bragging rights — you’ll conquer one of the toughest flights ever built.

GET READY TO RISE 

Face failure, pressure, and chaos — and come out more focused, more patient, and more

resilient than before.

Unfortunately, it’s not just about rising. You’re constantly under pressure, with the flood always behind you — rising, chasing, and waiting for a single mistake. It doesn’t give you time to think or space to rest. If you stop, slip, or hesitate, it catches you. 

Master the cave. Climb fast. Get out alive.
This is pure flying survival — no enemies, no checkpoints, and no second chances. Just you, your wings, and a flood that never stops rising. Your only goal? Escape the cave before it swallows you whole.

Fly with full control — or crash trying.
No training wheels here. Every twist, boost, and turn is on you. There’s no set path — just collapsing caves, narrow gaps, and wild terrain daring you to keep climbing. Water’s on your heels, and every second counts.

The cave changes every time you play.
No map. No shortcuts you can rely on. Just a massive, vertical maze that looks beautiful — right before it kills you. One wrong move and it’s back to the bottom. One clean run, and you might just make it out.

This game is all about the grind.
You’ll fail. A lot. But every mistake teaches you something. Some players take the careful route. Others find wild, high-risk shortcuts. However you climb, one thing’s for sure — you’ll earn every second you survive.

Forget easy mode.
This isn't some arcade flyer — you're in full control. Tilt, boost, balance… every move is on you. It feels amazing when you get it right — but if you don't, you're going down.

The water never stops.
It’s always rising, always hunting you down. Every second you waste, it gets closer. You’ve got one job: go up, stay ahead, and don’t look back — or it’s game over.

It’s tight in here.
You're dodging roots, weaving through rocks, and slipping through gaps that barely fit your wings. One twitch too wide and you're toast. Precision isn’t optional — it’s survival.

This game may be updated over time. Please note that future updates may increase the minimum system requirements beyond those currently listed. 

⚠️ This game contains flashing visuals that may trigger seizures for players with photosensitive epilepsy.

name: Fallbound

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i5-2500K 3.3GHz / AMD CPU Phenom II X4 940
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 or AMD R9 270
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i7 3770 3.4 GHz / AMD CPU AMD FX-8350 4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD R9 290X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Outfly the flood in a brutal vertical escape. Take control of an eagle in a world where every mistake costs you the climb. Rising water leaves no time for doubt — no guidance, no mercy. Just instinct, momentum, and the will to rise before it swallows you.
